summary: Busy Moggill Road shopping kerb with a bus lane and no parking convention.

best_section.where: Moggill Road kerb at the west end, by the Coles Local

drivers.seclusion: Retail on both sides and a busy shopping strip; no dwellings near, but fully in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a traffic lane edge beside a multi-lane arterial; only one car visible parked.
drivers.traffic: Heavy arterial traffic with buses and bus-stop activity.
drivers.convention: Signed short-stay and no-stopping zones; no sign of overnight parking.

sun_shade: Open to sun; building to the south shades the kerb from midday.
